1 Create data

bulk_Mar25_raw = read.table(
  file = input$rna_counts,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE
) %>% as.data.frame() 

bulk_Mar25_TPM = bulk_Mar25_raw %>%   dplyr::select(!c("Geneid","Chr", "Start", "End", "Strand","Length"))
rownames(bulk_Mar25_TPM) = make.unique(bulk_Mar25_TPM[,"gene_name",drop=T])
bulk_Mar25_TPM  = bulk_Mar25_TPM %>% dplyr::select(!c("gene_name"))
colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM) = gsub(pattern = ".bam",replacement = "",x = colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM))
#adjust sample names
#read xlsx file
library(readxl)
sample_description = readxl::read_xlsx(input$sample_description, sheet = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() 

 sample_description = sample_description %>%  mutate(new_name = paste(sample_description$`Group Name\r\n(Required)`,c(1:3),sep = "_")) 


bulk_Mar25_TPM = bulk_Mar25_TPM[,sample_description$`Sample Name`]
colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM) = sample_description$new_name
colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM)  = colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM) %>%  
  gsub(pattern = "_Osi_",replacement = "_osi_short_") %>% 
  gsub(pattern = "_OsiRox_",replacement = "_osi_short_roxa_") %>% 
  gsub(pattern = "_Per_",replacement = "_osi_persistor_") %>% 
  gsub(pattern = "_PerRox_",replacement = "_osi_persist_roxa_") 
# get cell line
cell_line_bulk = bulk_Mar25_TPM[,startsWith(colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM),params$cell_line)]
# create metadata
cell.labels = names(cell_line_bulk)
condition = str_extract(cell.labels, "Veh|osi_short_[1-9]|Rox|osi_short_roxa|osi_persistor|osi_persist_roxa") %>% gsub(pattern = "_[1-9]",replacement = "")
peristor = str_extract(cell.labels, "short|persist")
metadata = data.frame(condition = condition, row.names = colnames(cell_line_bulk))
library(DESeq2)

1.1 PCA

nrow(dds)
## [1] 60580
dds1 <- dds[ rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 3, ] # filter low count genes
nrow(dds1)
## [1] 23773
vst = vst(dds1, blind=FALSE)
## -- note: fitType='parametric', but the dispersion trend was not well captured by the
##    function: y = a/x + b, and a local regression fit was automatically substituted.

PCAdata <- prcomp(t(assay(vst)))
autoplot(PCAdata, data = metadata,colour = "condition",label = FALSE, main=paste(params$cell_line,"PCA")) +

1.2 DEG FC

genesets = getGmt(input$genesets) %>% geneIds()


dds <- DESeq(dds)
## estimating size factors
## estimating dispersions
## gene-wise dispersion estimates
## mean-dispersion relationship
## -- note: fitType='parametric', but the dispersion trend was not well captured by the
##    function: y = a/x + b, and a local regression fit was automatically substituted.
##    specify fitType='local' or 'mean' to avoid this message next time.
## final dispersion estimates
## fitting model and testing
cpVSop <- results(dds,contrast = c("condition","osi_persist_roxa","osi_persistor"))  %>% as.data.frame()
# cpVSop$padj = p.adjust(cpVSop$pvalue, method = "fdr")
roxaVSctrl <- results(dds,contrast = c("condition","Rox","Veh"))  %>% as.data.frame()
diff_genes = data.frame(row.names = rownames(cpVSop), 
                        cpVSop_FC = cpVSop$log2FoldChange,
                        roxaVSctrl_FC = roxaVSctrl$log2FoldChange, 
                        cpVSop_padj = cpVSop$padj)
# create 6 breaks between plot limits in log scale and then exponent, otherwise breaks not good
breaks_fun = function(limits){ 
  breaks = exp(-seq(-log(limits[1]), -log(limits[2]), length.out = 6))
  breaks[1] = breaks[1] * 0.95 #adjust extreme ticks to prevent truncation
  breaks[7] = breaks[7] * 1.05
  return(signif(breaks, digits = 2))
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(GSEABase))
ranked_vec = cpVSop[,"log2FoldChange"]%>% setNames(rownames(cpVSop)) %>% na.omit() %>%  #order by FC
  sort(decreasing = T) # sort
# add senesence signatures to genesets
SASP_signature = c("CCL2", "CCL5", "CCL7", "IL1A", "IL1B", "IL32","SCG2", "INHBA", "INHA", "WNT7A", "CSF2", "TNFRSF11B", "GREM1", "CMTM3")
FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP  = getGmt(input$SENESCENCE) %>% geneIds() %>%  unlist() %>% base::unname()

genesets = c(genesets, list(SASP = SASP_signature,
                        FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP = FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP))


hyp_obj <- hypeR_fgsea(ranked_vec, genesets, up_only = F)
## Loading required package: hypeR
## Warning in preparePathwaysAndStats(pathways, stats, minSize, maxSize, gseaParam, : There are ties in the preranked stats (10.47% of the list).
## The order of those tied genes will be arbitrary, which may produce unexpected results.
plt = hyp_dots(hyp_obj,merge = F)
plt1 = plt$up+ aes(size=nes)+ggtitle("up in comboPersistor")+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = hypeR:::.reverselog_trans(10), 
        breaks =breaks_fun)
## Scale for y is already present.
## Adding another scale for y, which will replace the existing scale.
plt2 = plt$dn+ aes(size=abs(nes))+ggtitle("up in osiPersistors")+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = hypeR:::.reverselog_trans(10), 
        breaks =breaks_fun)
## Scale for y is already present.
## Adding another scale for y, which will replace the existing scale.
print_tab(plt1+plt2,title = paste(params$cell_line,"cpVSop"))

HCC cpVSop

ranked_vec = roxaVSctrl[,"log2FoldChange"]%>% setNames(rownames(roxaVSctrl)) %>% na.omit() %>% # make named vector
  sort(decreasing = T) # sort 

hyp_obj <- hypeR_fgsea(ranked_vec, genesets, up_only = F)
## Warning in preparePathwaysAndStats(pathways, stats, minSize, maxSize, gseaParam, : There are ties in the preranked stats (6.85% of the list).

## Scale for y is already present.

plt2 = plt$dn+ aes(size=abs(nes))+ggtitle("up in ctrl")+

        breaks =breaks_fun)

HCC roxaVSctrl

2 DEG in comboVSosi but not in roxaVSctrl

diff_genes = data.frame(row.names = rownames(cpVSop), 
                        cpVSop_FC = 2**cpVSop$log2FoldChange,
                        roxaVSctrl_FC = 2**roxaVSctrl$log2FoldChange,
                        cpVSop_padj = cpVSop$padj)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
## 
up_genes_df =  diff_genes %>% filter(cpVSop_FC > 2 & roxaVSctrl_FC<1.2 & cpVSop_padj<0.05) 
down_genes_df = diff_genes %>% filter(cpVSop_FC < 0.5 & roxaVSctrl_FC>0.8 & cpVSop_padj<0.05)
up_genes = up_genes_df %>% rownames()
down_genes = down_genes_df %>% rownames()

gene_descriptions <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = up_genes, columns = "GENENAME", keytype = "SYMBOL")
## 'select()' returned 1:1 mapping between keys and columns
print_tab(cbind(up_genes_df,gene_description = gene_descriptions$GENENAME),
          title = "up")
## ##   up {.unnumbered }  
##  
##       cpVSop_FC roxaVSctrl_FC  cpVSop_padj  gene_description
## EDN2   2.050863     0.9162895 4.329427e-34      endothelin 2
## HK2    3.008337     1.1419718 4.134101e-13      hexokinase 2
## APOL1  2.151577     1.1714727 1.208509e-62 apolipoprotein L1
## 
gene_descriptions <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = down_genes, columns = "GENENAME", keytype = "SYMBOL")

print_tab(cbind(down_genes_df,gene_description = gene_descriptions$GENENAME),
          title = "down")
## ##   down {.unnumbered }  
##  
## [1] cpVSop_FC        roxaVSctrl_FC    cpVSop_padj      gene_description
## <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
## 
#Genes from H1975
diff_genes[c("TGFBI", "KRT17"),]
diff_genes[c("ALPG", "ALDH3B1", "ANPEP", "TPSP2"),]
#TGFB
diff_genes[c("SMAD2","SMAD3","SMAD4","TGFB1","TGFB2","TGFB3","TGFBR1","TGFBR2"),]
# write a data frame from the list of up and down genes
lst = list(up_genes = up_genes, down_genes = down_genes)
df_from_list <- bind_rows(lapply(lst, function(x) as.data.frame(t(x)))) %>% set_rownames(names(lst)) %>% t()

write.table(df_from_list,
            file = paste0(params$data_out_dir, paste0(basename(output$up_in_persistors))),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
if(length(up_genes)>=3){
  hyp_obj <- hypeR(up_genes, genesets, test = "hypergeometric", fdr=1, plotting=F,
                 background = rownames(bulk_Mar25_TPM))
  plt1 = hyp_dots(hyp_obj,title = paste("up in comboVSosi but not in roxaVSctrl -",params$cell_line))
  print(plt1)
}

if(length(down_genes)>=3){
  hyp_obj <- hypeR(down_genes, genesets, test = "hypergeometric", fdr=1, plotting=F,
                   background = rownames(bulk_Mar25_TPM))
  plt2 = hyp_dots(hyp_obj,title = paste("down in comboVSosi but not in roxaVSctrl - ",params$cell_line))
  print(plt2)
}
